lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs => exact Or.inl (Value.abs der.wf.2.1)
  case tabs => exact Or.inl (Value.tabs der.wf.2.1)

            grind

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exact Or.inr ⟨u ^ᵗᵗ t₂, Red.abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
        | inr ⟨t₂', red⟩ => exact Or.inr ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red⟩
    | inr ⟨t₁', red⟩ => exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red⟩
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have body : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val body⟩
    | inr ⟨t₁', red⟩ => exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind red body⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (Value.inl val)
    | inr ⟨t', red⟩ => exact Or.inr ⟨.inl t', Red.inl red⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (Value.inr val)
    | inr ⟨t', red⟩ => exact Or.inr ⟨.inr t', Red.inr red⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exact Or.inr ⟨u ^ᵗᵗ t₂, Red.abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', red_r⟩ := red_r
            exact Or.inr ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', red_l⟩ := red_l
        exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have body : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val body⟩
    | inr red₁ =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', red₁⟩ := red₁
        exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind red₁ body⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (Value.inl val)
    | inr red₁ =>
        obtain ⟨t', red₁⟩ := red₁
        exact Or.inr ⟨.inl t', Red.inl red₁⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (Value.inr val)
    | inr red₁ =>
        obtain ⟨t', red₁⟩ := red₁
        exact Or.inr ⟨.inr t', Red.inr red₁⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
